name: spider-crawls
instructions:
1. Assume a standing position with your fingertips against a wall and a band wrapped around your wrists.
2. Slowly begin to walk your hands vertically up the wall while maintaining tension on the band.
3. Walk your fingertips up the wall until your elbows are extended and shoulders are flexed.
4. Slowly walk your fingertips back down the wall and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
